Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a red light in the left lane of the roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, when the vehicle was struck
from behind by Driver 2, whose vehicle was traveling at a speed that did not allow a timely stop. Driver 1 reported
pain in the head and was told by the responding paramedics that a concussion was possible; the reported injury is
consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type. The Passenger, seated in the rear, was also present
and reported no injury at the scene. Driver 2 stated that the events occurred as Driver 1 described, and two
independent witnesses at the intersection gave statements that match that account. Photographs taken at the scene
show rear damage to Driver 1's vehicle, and the location and pattern of that damage correspond with the impact
described by all parties. Officers observed no prior damage to either vehicle that would suggest an earlier incident.
Driver 1 confirmed ownership of the vehicle and is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy covering it. Both
vehicles were driven from the scene after the exchange of information, and Driver 2 was issued a citation for following
too closely.
